FANTIK-AUTOMATIONS.Settings.DisableOwn.H: Turn off all automations for your own items, spells, and features on this client. Effects other casters placed on you and module fixes (vision, targeting) keep working. Per-player setting.
FANTIK-AUTOMATIONS.Manager.Title: Automations: {name}
FANTIK-AUTOMATIONS.Manager.GMOnlyHint: Only a Game Master can apply or remove this automation.
FANTIK-AUTOMATIONS.Manager.GMOnlyNotice: Only a Game Master can apply, remove, or configure this automation.
FANTIK-AUTOMATIONS.Manager.GMOnlyWarning: Only a Game Master can manage this automation.
FANTIK-AUTOMATIONS.Manager.ByNameHint: This automation matches the item's name, so it applies automatically. Removing it stores an explicit exclusion on the item.
FANTIK-AUTOMATIONS.Manager.WorldDisabled: This automation is turned off in the module settings, so it won't run even when applied to the item.
